title: Transfer of Reed-Muller local testing to multiplicity codes with quantitative soundness

standard_prerequisites.name: Reed-Muller distance bound [10], standard Hasse derivative restriction identity [15], Markov and Schwartz-Zippel bounds
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author Lemmas11,15,17 and exact alphabet-reduction definition48 retained. Main statement retains the assumed RM tester soundness instead of claiming it unconditionally.

core_obligations: Extract a global low-degree polynomial from the zero-derivative evaluation table.
Use distance and Markov bounds to quantify affine restrictions agreeing with this global polynomial.
Recover all Hasse derivative coordinates from sufficiently many good line restrictions using Schwartz-Zippel.
Derive the exact transferred rejection coefficient without changing the input tester assumption.
difficulty_reason: Connects zero-level RM consistency to all multiplicity coordinates through affine-space sampling, many linear constraints on Hasse derivatives, and a homogeneous-polynomial zero test. This is an independent quantitative tester-transfer theorem; its numerical corollary is not counted separately.

dedup.scope: Root checked exact DOI and confirmed eccc:TR22-028 across complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both lines without neighbors. Counts the main RM-to-MRM testing transfer Theorem51 once; supporting Claims53–56 and explicit-dimension Corollary52 are uncounted. Plane characterization/main plane tester are distinct remaining source contributions.

locator_notes: Faithful official Theorem51 (introduction Theorem4) with full Section5.1 proof and necessary author context. Source-local proof reproduced without mathematical repairs; author notational slips remain as published. The testing-dimension numerical corollary52 is not separately counted or needed for this conditional transfer statement. arxiv2202.08688 was checked and is unrelated, so it is not an alias or text source.
